guides.title: Webcam Source · setup
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Pick a camera
steps.body: In the Camera card, read Camera status, then open Capture camera and choose your webcam. Refresh cameras reloads the device list. A device shown in the list is not proof it captures; only a status indicating readiness means the source can capture snapshots for chat turns or the hidden loop.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Confirm capture status
steps.body: After choosing a camera, let the status settle and read it. On some systems another app holds the camera, producing a status that is not ready. Release that app and refresh cameras. Seeing a usable status means the source can capture; snapshot attachment still happens through chat turns or the hidden loop.

steps.title: Guide how snapshots are described
steps.body: The prompts tab contains wording that shapes how webcam snapshots are interpreted in chat. Read existing text before editing. Base any change on the wording you can see. Afterward, check one turn to confirm the snapshot is described as intended.

steps.title: Inspect advanced options in place
steps.body: The advanced tab holds less common Webcam Source settings. Read them where they are instead of assuming names. Change one at a time and verify with a snapshot-bearing turn, since camera capture is stateful and a stale status can mislead you.
